item.title: CoreWeave revenue doubles as AI demand surges
item.summary: CoreWeave shares jumped in the US pre-market after announcing that revenue more than doubled in the second quarter as demand for AI computing power continued to surge, though losses from its debt-fuelled expansion continued to mount. There would have been a level of nervousness going into earnings given the choppiness in AI-related stocks recently, but […] The post CoreWeave revenue doubles as AI demand surges appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
